About this hub

Toolstack Lab’s public shelf for tiny browser 3D games we made ourselves. No accounts, no cookies, no third-party scripts or fonts. Click Play and the game docks into the play bay.

What you get

  • Self-made games with recorded licence and source in each detail page.
  • On-click iframe play (or open in a new tab) — nothing heavy loads until you ask.
  • Popularity sorted by a documented formula; “recently played” stays on your device only.

Lab cartridge metaphor

Home cards are labeled cartridges on a workbench. Hover flips the label through a real screenshot. Play docks the cartridge into a glowing bay — a cheap, memorable interaction without video or 3D backgrounds.

Audience & boundaries

Pip's Bloom Isle is aimed at casual players 13+. We only list what each build already ships. See the content policy for licence rules.
